title: DFT structure relaxation
action: Set up the trigonal H3[Co(CN)6] structure (space group P-31m) from the public CIF and perform DFT relaxation of lattice parameters and atomic positions using Quantum ESPRESSO with the PBE functional.
description: Obtain the relaxed equilibrium lattice constants and atomic coordinates required for subsequent elastic and phonon calculations.

title: Phonon and Grüneisen parameter calculations
action: Using Phonopy and Quantum ESPRESSO DFPT: compute (1) elastic constants at the relaxed volume; (2) zone-center phonon frequencies and eigenvectors; (3) DFPT forces at volumes varied by ±10% around equilibrium; (4) fit volume-energy data to the Birch-Murnaghan equation of state to obtain bulk modulus B0; (5) compute mode Grüneisen parameters for all optical modes via finite-volume differences.
description: Core computational step producing the raw data for the scored mode and thermal expansion artifacts.

title: Output mode Grüneisen parameters table
action: Assemble the computed zone-center optical phonon frequencies and their mode Grüneisen parameters into a CSV file.
description: Table listing all optical zone-center modes with their frequencies, symmetry labels (if identifiable), Grüneisen parameters, and degeneracies. Must include at least two modes with negative Grüneisen parameters.
output_schema: Columns: mode_index (int), frequency_cm1 (float), symmetry (str), gamma (float), degeneracy (int). One row per optical branch.

title: Output thermal expansion coefficient
action: Compute the volumetric thermal expansion coefficient at 300 K using the mode Grüneisen parameters, bulk modulus, and molar volume under the Einstein model within the quasiharmonic approximation. Write the results to a JSON file.
description: Scored artifact containing relaxed lattice parameters, bulk modulus, and thermal expansion coefficient at 300 K. The checker will recompute the thermal expansion coefficient from the mode_gruneisen.csv and compare to the paper-reported value.
